fisher_lda_fit — SEGMENTATION classify op

• Data kinds: matrix × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fisher_lda_fit(X, y, *, ridge: 'float' = 1e-06, prior1: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import cropweed; cropweed.fisher_lda_fit(X, y, *, ridge: 'float' = 1e-06, prior1: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("fisher_lda_fit"))

Usage

Fit a two-class Fisher linear discriminant (closed form, no iteration).

X is (N, D) features (the dict returned by superpixel_color_texture_features can be passed as is), y is N class labels 0 / 1. Features are standardised by the overall mean and standard deviation (columns with zero variance keep scale 1 and are recorded in constant_columns); ridge × tr(Σ)/D is added to the pooled within-class covariance Σ = (S₀ + S₁)/(N − 2), then w = Σ⁻¹(μ₁ − μ₀). The intercept is the point where the log-likelihood ratio of the two equal-variance normals w·z − w·(μ₀ + μ₁)/2 + log(π₁/π₀) is 0 (prior1 = π₁, default = the share in the training data).

Returns: w, bias (score = z·w + bias, positive = class 1), mean, scale, mu0, mu1, fisher_ratio (J = (w·Δμ)²/(wᵀΣw), separation strength), n0, n1, prior1, constant_columns, cond. Empty input, y not 0/1, fewer than 2 samples per class, N ≤ 2, covariance condition number above 1e12 (direction undetermined) and equal class means (J = 0) raise ValueError.
